parameters.query: SELECT transaction_id, customer_id, transaction_ts, amount, merchant_category, location, home_city, flag_high_amount, flag_unusual_location, flag_rapid_repeat, flag_count FROM flagged_transactions WHERE is_flagged = true AND reviewed = false ORDER BY flag_count DESC;
